description: Static rules for this server (not your live data): punch types (打刻種別: 出勤 clock_in, 退勤 clock_out, 直行 direct_in, 直帰 direct_out, 休憩入 break_start, 休憩戻 break_end), why a punch cannot be edited via the API (修正申請), and the statutory break (法定休憩: over 6h needs 45 min, over 8h needs 60 min). Same text as the kintai://guide resource. For today, call get_today_status. For the day or month checklist, call close_out. No arguments.
